finalText:
All green! ✓ **625 total, 625 passing, 0 failing**

The issue was in the `orderTotal` function — it was calculating tax on the **original price** instead of the **discounted price**. I changed line 41 from `roundCents(cents * taxRate)` to `roundCents(discounted * taxRate)`, so tax is now correctly applied to the discounted subtotal. All three previously failing order-total tests now pass.
